name: multiple-blocks
formula: import NativeDemo#add as add; import NativeSecond#twice as twice; external returning as number twice(external returning as number add(2,3))

name: scoped-context
formula: import NativeDemo#scoped as scoped; var $x as number set 7; external returning as number scoped()

name: string-context
formula: import NativeDemo#greet as greet; external returning as string greet($name)

name: boolean-true
formula: import NativeDemo#digits as digits; if(external returning as boolean digits('123')){1}else{0}

name: boolean-false
formula: import NativeDemo#digits as digits; if(external returning as boolean digits('abc')){1}else{0}

name: side-effect-order
formula: import NativeDemo#next as next; (external returning as number next()) * 10 + (external returning as number next())

name: short-circuit
formula: import NativeDemo#next as next; if(false){external returning as number next()}else{external returning as number next()}

name: float-string
formula: import NativeDemo#floatArg as f; external returning as number f('1.25')

name: invalid-int-string
formula: import NativeDemo#intArg as f; external returning as number f('not a number')

name: double
formula: import NativeDemo#doubleArg as f; external returning as number f($v)

name: long
formula: import NativeDemo#longArg as f; external returning as number f($v)

name: short
formula: import NativeDemo#shortArg as f; external returning as number f($v as object)

name: byte
formula: import NativeDemo#byteArg as f; external returning as number f($v as object)

name: byte-widening
formula: import NativeDemo#shortArg as f; external returning as number f($v as object)

name: boolean-conversion
formula: import NativeDemo#boolArg as f; if(external returning as boolean f('TrUe')){1}else{0}

name: null-root-is-rejected
formula: import NativeDemo#nullable as f; external returning as object f($missing as object)

name: missing-argument-is-zero
formula: import NativeDemo#isNull as n; if(external returning as boolean n($missing as object)){1}else{0}

name: nested-null-string-coercion
formula: import NativeDemo#nullable as f; import NativeDemo#isNull as n; if(external returning as boolean n(external returning as object f($missing as object))){1}else{0}

name: missing-primitive-is-zero

name: wrong-short-type

name: unregistered
formula: import Declared#f as f; external returning as number f()

name: object-roundtrip
formula: import NativeDemo#object as make; import NativeDemo#objectText as text; var $v as object set external returning as object make(); external returning as string text($v as object)

name: opaque-root

name: boxed-identity
